name: infeasible-story
description: Language support for the infeasible .story surface language: diagnostics, go-to-definition, find-references, outline, and dependency/attacker-cone hovers — served by the native story-lsp server.

story.serverPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `story-lsp` executable. A bare name is looked up on `PATH`; a relative path resolves against the workspace root. When left at the default, a `build/story-lsp` under the workspace is preferred if present (the CMake build output).

story.trace.server.description: Trace the JSON-RPC traffic between VS Code and story-lsp (in the '.story' output channel).
